title: NeXT vs Sun
summary: A 1991 NeXT promotional video that stages a head-to-head programming contest between a NeXT computer and a Sun workstation. It shows NeXT's interface builder and object-oriented tooling producing an application far faster than traditional UNIX development.
why: HN uses it as the canonical example of rapid application development and object-oriented tooling productivity, though many note it is biased marketing.

quote.text: I don't know how realistic is this video but it was interesting
